mentions.name: Mojave Paint
mentions.description: A macOS paint app featuring layers, alpha masks, selections, foreground/background color, gradients, and halftone edges, aiming to be an affordable alternative to expensive or underwhelming image editors.
mentions.problem: Photoshop is expensive and invasive on the machine, while the free alternative Affinity is underwhelming; the app targets the "awesome and cheap" quadrant.
mentions.source_excerpt: my new macOS paint app, called Mojave Paint

mentions.name: Image editor for macOS
mentions.description: A native image editor for macOS, built as an alternative to Affinity and GIMP.
mentions.problem: Existing macOS image editors such as Affinity and GIMP don't satisfy the author, so they decided to build their own.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building an image editor for macOS. Don't really like Affinity or GIMP so thought I'd go ahead and make my own. https://skullrocksoftware.com
